description: Defines a GD image cropping operation class for Drupal's image toolkit, including argument validation and execution logic.

classes.name: Crop
classes.description: A class implementing a crop operation for GD images within Drupal's image toolkit.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Defines the arguments for the crop operation, including x, y, width, and height.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates and adjusts the provided arguments for cropping, ensuring at least one dimension is specified and dimensions are positive integers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the cropping operation by creating a new image and resampling the original into it.
